embeds.title: 🔴 Malicious npm Package Steals Files from Anthropic Claude AI Tool Directory
embeds.description:
OX Security discovered a malicious npm package named 'mouse5212-super-formatter' that steals files from Anthropic's Claude AI tool directory (/mnt/user-data). The package, codenamed Malware-Slop, masquerades as an internal archive deployment utility and uploads stolen files to a threat actor-controlled GitHub account using either stolen or hard-coded GitHub tokens. The package was downloaded 676 times before being identified, though actual install count is unclear. The GitHub account used in the campaign was created on May 26, 2026, hours before the malicious version was uploaded to npm.
**Sources:** thehackernews.com • 🟡 2 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Malicious npm package installation
**Incident date:** 2026-05-26 • **Confidence:** claim
